name: qiaomu-opencli-explorer
title_zh: 把任意网站变成可用的命令行工具
tagline_zh: 对着 DevTools 抓包太累？说一句“生成 xxx.com 的 CLI”，它自动摸清 API、选认证。
tagline_en: Tired of digging through DevTools? Say “make a CLI for xxx.com” and it maps APIs, picks auth, writes the adapter.
desc_en: Use when creating a new OpenCLI adapter from scratch, adding support for a new website or platform, exploring a site's API endpoints via browser DevTools, or when a user asks to automatically generate a CLI for a website (e.g. "帮我生成 xxx.com 的 cli"). Covers automated generation, API discovery workflow, authentication strategy selection, TS adapter writing, and testing.
why_zh: 不是模板填充，而是按真实流量走一遍发现端点，再按站点特性选认证策略，最后产出可测的 TS 适配器——像。
why_en: Not template stuffing—it traces real traffic to find endpoints, picks auth per site, then ships a testable TS adapter. Like.
limit_zh: 只覆盖从零新建适配器的全流程；已有适配器的改造、非浏览器可访问的 API（如移动端私有协议）、以及需要登录态但无 We。
limit_en: Only greenfield adapter creation. Won't retrofit existing adapters, handle non-browser APIs (e.g. mobile private protocols), or sites with no web.
